instruction: Use GIMP to apply a blur filter to the entire video at "/home/user/fullvideo.mp4" and export it as a new video file.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because GIMP cannot apply filters to video files. While GIMP has powerful image filters including blur, it only works on static images, not video streams. Video filtering requires video editing software like FFmpeg or video editors.

llm_judge_reasons: Task is correctly identified as infeasible - GIMP is an image editor and cannot process video files
The evaluator correctly uses the 'infeasible()' function, which is the appropriate special-case evaluator for tasks that cannot be completed as specified
The explanation accurately describes why the task cannot be completed (GIMP only works on static images, not video streams)
No verification logic is needed because the task itself is fundamentally impossible to complete with the specified tool
